case_name: Estate of Andrews, C. Appeal of:Winsor, J.

issues.label: Burden of proof for fee reasonableness
issues.why: Court must decide whether the executor and counsel bear the initial burden of proving reasonableness or whether objectants bear the burden to disprove it.

issues.label: Proper legal standard for attorney fees
issues.why: Court must determine whether LaRocca's multi-factor reasonableness analysis governs or whether the Donofrio percentage guidelines suffice.

issues.label: Proper standard for executor commissions
issues.why: Court must decide whether commissions require a reasonableness analysis independent of the flat percentage guidelines.

issues.label: Precedential weight of Donofrio guidelines
issues.why: Court must assess whether a local Orphans' Court opinion can override Supreme Court reasonableness precedent.

issues.label: Guidelines as prima facie vs. conclusive
issues.why: Court must decide whether within-guidelines fees are conclusively reasonable or merely presumptively so subject to rebuttal.

issues.label: Whether within-guidelines fees escape scrutiny
issues.why: Court must determine if the red-flag/no-review framework applies only to above-guideline fees while still requiring some review here.

issues.label: Relevance of estate size to reasonableness
issues.why: Court must consider whether flat percentages remain reasonable for a $2.28M estate far larger than Donofrio's.

issues.label: Relevance of hours worked and time records
issues.why: Court must weigh the significance of counsel and executor not tracking time when assessing reasonableness.

issues.label: Complexity of the estate
issues.why: Court must evaluate the estate's routine vs. 'less than routine' character in applying the reasonableness factors.

issues.label: Qualifying interested counsel as expert
issues.why: Court must decide whether counsel may be qualified as expert on the reasonableness of his own fees and his client's commissions.

issues.label: Admissibility/weight of interested expert opinion
issues.why: Court must determine what weight an interested witness's expert opinion deserves given the conflict of interest.

issues.label: Department of Revenue non-objection as evidence
issues.why: Court must assess whether the taxing authority's failure to reject fees probates their reasonableness.

issues.label: Denial of continuance for objectants' expert
issues.why: Court must evaluate whether refusing a continuance to present objectants' expert was an abuse of discretion.

issues.label: Objectants' mistaken belief re hearing nature
issues.why: Court must consider whether reliance on a status-hearing assumption justified additional time.

issues.label: Nonsuit/directed verdict standard
issues.why: Court must apply the proper standard for granting a compulsory nonsuit in a non-jury Orphans' Court proceeding.

issues.label: Fiduciary exception to attorney-client privilege
issues.why: Court must decide whether communications between executor and counsel regarding fees are discoverable by beneficiaries.

issues.label: Availability and standard for surcharge
issues.why: Court must determine whether excessive fees or commissions warrant surcharging the fiduciaries.

issues.label: Successor executor's duty regarding prior fees
issues.why: Court must consider the successor executor's obligation to review and challenge the deceased predecessor's payments.

issues.label: Deceased executor's commission reasonableness
issues.why: Court must assess a commission paid to Willison whose actual work and hours are unknown and unprovable.

issues.label: CPA accounting fee objection
issues.why: Court must rule on the challenged $10,789.94 payment to the accountants, which received little evidentiary attention.

issues.label: Preservation of issues in 1925(b) statement
issues.why: Court must ensure the errors complained of were properly preserved and adequately specified for appeal.

issues.label: Finality and appealability of orders
issues.why: Court must confirm the July 2025 decree is final and the appeal properly taken after the earlier quashal.

issues.label: Standard of review on appeal
issues.why: Reviewing court must apply the abuse-of-discretion standard to Orphans' Court fee determinations.

issues.label: Court's own factual findings vs. deference to local practice
issues.why: Court must determine whether it improperly substituted local custom for the individualized reasonableness inquiry required.

issues.label: Adequacy of evidentiary record on reasonableness
issues.why: Court must decide whether the record contains sufficient evidence of work performed to support the reasonableness finding.
